{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check unique values in the severity column to confirm 'SEVERE' is used
print('Unique values in severity column:', data['severity'].unique())

# Check the baseline biomarker column for any sentinel values
print('Baseline biomarker values (first 10):', data['biomarker_baseline'].head(10).values)

# Check for any missing or invalid values in baseline biomarker
print('Missing values in biomarker_baseline:', data['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum())

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0) that might indicate missing or invalid data
sentinel_value = -999.0
print(f'Sentinel value {sentinel_value} count:', (data['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum())"}
